decision_conditions: The submitted Energy Statement has failed to adequately demonstrate that the development would achieve CO"² emission reductions of not less than 35% over Part L of the Building Regulations 2013. The submission does not provide sufficient evidence to quantify the overall carbon savings arising from the proposed energy efficiency measures and renewable energy technologies, nor does it demonstrate that the maximum achievable improvements in energy efficiency and carbon reduction have been incorporated into the development. The Local Planning Authority is therefore unable to conclude that the proposal complies with the requirements of the condition, Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
